intro.text: A corrupt minister who runs a prison in a small town on the northern edge of the Purelake.

items.text: Kwati was paid to run a prison for convicts from across the region, and tattooed their foreheads so they could be recognised. When some escaped, he sent for the Skybreakers to hunt them down, since escape carried a death sentence, and then complained they had taken too long.

Szeth found the prison dark, filthy and guarded by a single man, and accused Kwati of pocketing the money meant to run it. Ki had already known; working out Kwati's guilt was part of Szeth's test. Once Ki confirmed Kwati was to be executed, Szeth killed him with Nightblood, destroying both body and soul.

appearance.text: Tall and beefy, he wears a Marabethian wrap with an Azish coat and is clearly a nobleman.

personality.text: He speaks Azish and is overbearing and haughty.
